answer: Randomness-gated enrollment grove. Each agent ID must claim a slot in a grove: a commit-reveal lottery seeded by a threshold BLS beacon reveals after enrollment closes, so slots and co-membership cannot be precomputed or steered. Membership is a relic earned only if the revealed slot matches the committed one; mismatch forfeits the deposit. An attacker cannot know which grove or co-members their fake IDs land in, so coordination is blind. Each surviving ID costs a fresh commitment plus a real hardware attestation under an umber rate limit,
